data.text:
Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David, Bishop of Kalookan, presides over the Mass for the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution during the “Prayer Power sa EDSA” prayer rally at the EDSA Shrine in Quezon City on Sunday, Feb. 22.

Among those present were Sen. Bam Aquino, Akbayan Party-list Reps. Chel Diokno and Perci Cendaña, former presidential adviser Ronald Llamas, television host Edu Manzano, and actress Iza Calzado.

(Photos by Nadine T. Felismino, Djenhard Yreneo Raphael Y. Sapanhila, and Joachim Nigel Z. Tanglao/ The Varsitarian)

data.text:
‘TAYO ANG PEOPLE POWER’

LOOK: The August Twenty-One Movement (ATOM) held the ROAR! Walk for People Power and Ride for People Power activities in Quezon City on Sunday, Feb. 22.

"Today is the 40th anniversary of the night when Butz Aquino of ATOM appealed to the people on Radio Veritas, including his Atom and Bandila members, to converge at the Isetann, Cubao. This was the birth of People Power,” ATOM President Volt Bohol said.

He added, "Kahit na this was declared a working holiday on the 25th, walang papasok!"

The motorcade later proceeded to the EDSA Shrine to join the mass and prayer rally in remembrance of the historic uprising. | 📷: ATOM
